bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the proportional representation of male and female individuals in image retrieval results for various occupation queries using the Multi-Group Proportional Representation (MPR) metric against a target reference distribution.
Measuring the representation of different racial groups (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Indian, Others) in top-k retrieved images compared to a balanced curated dataset using the MPR metric.
Assessing the proportional representation of different age demographics in facial image retrieval tasks using the MPR framework alongside other demographic attributes.

Evaluating the worst-case deviation of representation statistics across complex intersectional groups (combinations of gender, race, and age) using bounded complexity function classes (e.g., linear models, decision trees) to compute the MPR metric.
